WORKBOOK 4-UNITNING UChINChI BETI (18-bet). Yuqorida chapda to'q sariq '4' va 'Days to Remember'.

CHAP USTUN:
8) 'Look at the picture and the story extract, then correct the statements below, as in the example.' KATTA RASM (qal'a ichi, turistlar): Jane - eshikda, xonaga kirib kelyapti (qo'li ko'tarilgan); Guide (gid) - formada, qo'li bilan ko'rsatib gapiryapti; Ali va Maya - gidni tinglashyapti; Harry - zinadan tushib kelyapti; Mick - o'rtada turib rasmga qarayapti; Mr West - quti ustida o'tiribdi; Mr Brown - fotoapparat bilan suratga olyapti. Devorda katta manzara rasmi, qandil, shamdon. HIKOYA PARChASI (quti): 'There were a lot of tourists in the castle. Suddenly, there was a terrible scream....'
  1 Harry was talking to Ali and Maya. ...Harry wasn't talking to Ali and Maya. He was coming down the stairs.... 2 Jane was looking at the painting. 3 The guide was sitting on a box. 4 Ali and Maya were listening to Harry. 5 Mick was taking a photograph. 6 Mr West was walking into the room. 7 Mr Brown was listening to the guide.

O'NG USTUN:
9) 'Use the prompts to make sentences with the past simple and/or the past continuous.' 1 Pam / scream / when / she / see / the stranger in her house; 2 the thieves / steal / the painting / while / guard / not look; 3 the man in the photo / wear / an old suit / and / hold / a blue umbrella; 4 it / snow / heavily / as / the climbers / reach / the camp; 5 he / walk / in the park / when / he / find / a set of keys; 6 it / stop / raining / so / the children / go out / to play; 7 the loudspeaker / break / while / the band / play / their first song.

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '18'.

exercises.explanationUz:
PAST CONTINUOUS - QIChQIRIQ
  PAYTIDA KIM NIMA QILAYOTGAN EDI
  (coursebook 29-bet 19-mashq
  kabi).

  QOLIP:
  X WASN'T/WEREN'T + V-ing ...
  He/She/They WAS/WERE + V-ing ...


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'Harry wasn't talking to Ali and
   Maya. He was coming down the
   stairs.'


RASMDA:

  Jane - xonaga KIRIB KELYAPTI
  Guide - turistlarga GAPIRYAPTI
    (qo'li bilan ko'rsatyapti)
  Ali, Maya - GIDNI tinglashyapti
  Harry - ZINADAN tushyapti
  Mick - RASMGA qarayapti
  Mr West - QUTI USTIDA o'tiribdi
  Mr Brown - SURATGA olyapti


⚠ 'A TERRIBLE SCREAM':

  = dahshatli qichqiriq. Hikoya
  boshlanishi - 'Suddenly' bilan.


⚠ 'A GUIDE':

  = gid, yo'l boshlovchi.


⚠ 'A CASTLE':

  = qal'a. /ˈkɑːsl/ - 't'
  O'QILMAYDI.
exercises.exampleEn: Harry wasn't talking to Ali and Maya. He was coming down the stairs.
exercises.exampleUz: Harri Ali va Maya bilan gaplashmayotgan edi. U zinadan tushib kelayotgan edi.
modelAnswers: Jane wasn't looking at the painting. She was walking into the room.
The guide wasn't sitting on a box. He was talking to the tourists.
Ali and Maya weren't listening to Harry. They were listening to the guide.
Mick wasn't taking a photograph. He was looking at the painting.
Mr West wasn't walking into the room. He was sitting on a box.
Mr Brown wasn't listening to the guide. He was taking a photograph.
modelAnswersUz: Jeyn rasmga qaramayotgan edi. U xonaga kirib kelayotgan edi.
Gid quti ustida o'tirmagan edi. U turistlarga gapirayotgan edi.
Ali va Maya Harrini tinglamayotgan edilar. Ular gidni tinglayotgan edilar.
Mik suratga olmayotgan edi. U rasmga qarayotgan edi.
Janob Uest xonaga kirmayotgan edi. U quti ustida o'tirgan edi.
Janob Braun gidni tinglamayotgan edi. U suratga olayotgan edi.

exercises.instructionUz: Ko'rsatmalar bilan past simple va/yoki past continuous'da gaplar tuzing. 1 Pam / scream / when / she / see / the stranger in her house 2 the thieves / steal / the painting / while / guard / not look 3 the man in the photo / wear / an old suit / and / hold / a blue umbrella 4 it / snow / heavily / as / the climbers / reach / the camp 5 he / walk / in the park / when / he / find / a set of keys 6 it / stop / raining / so / the children / go out / to play 7 the loudspeaker / break / while / the band / play / their first song
exercises.explanationUz:
PAST SIMPLE va/yoki PAST
  CONTINUOUS - KO'RSATMALARDAN.

  ⚠ BOG'LOVChIGA QARANG:
  WHEN + past simple (qisqa voqea):
    1 'screamed WHEN she saw'
      (ikkala ham qisqa → ikkala
      simple)
    5 'was walking WHEN he found'
  WHILE/AS + past continuous
  (davomiy fon):
    2 'stole ... WHILE the guard
      wasn't looking'
    4 'was snowing AS the climbers
      reached'
    7 'broke WHILE the band was
      playing'
  SO - ketma-ket (ikkala simple):
    6 'stopped raining, SO the
      children went out'
  TASVIR (surat) - continuous:
    3 'was wearing ... and was
      holding'


NOQONUNIY FE'LLAR:

  see → SAW, steal → STOLE,
  find → FOUND, go → WENT,
  break → BROKE.


⚠ 'A SET OF KEYS':

  = bir dasta kalit.


⚠ 'A LOUDSPEAKER':

  = karnay (ovoz kuchaytirgich).


⚠ 'A GUARD':

  = qo'riqchi.


⚠ 'THE CLIMBERS':

  = alpinistlar. 'the camp' =
  lager.
exercises.exampleEn: Pam screamed when she saw the stranger in her house.
exercises.exampleUz: Pam uyida notanish odamni ko'rganda qichqirdi.
modelAnswers: Pam screamed when she saw the stranger in her house.
The thieves stole the painting while the guard wasn't looking.
The man in the photo was wearing an old suit and was holding a blue umbrella.
It was snowing heavily as the climbers reached the camp.
He was walking in the park when he found a set of keys.
It stopped raining, so the children went out to play.
The loudspeaker broke while the band was playing their first song.
modelAnswersUz: Pam uyida notanish odamni ko'rganda qichqirdi.
O'g'rilar qo'riqchi qaramayotgan paytda rasmni o'g'irlashdi.
Suratdagi erkak eski kostyum kiygan va ko'k soyabon ushlab turgan edi.
Alpinistlar lagerga yetib kelganda qattiq qor yog'ayotgan edi.
U bog'da sayr qilayotganda bir dasta kalit topdi.
Yomg'ir to'xtadi, shuning uchun bolalar o'ynagani tashqariga chiqishdi.
Guruh birinchi qo'shig'ini ijro etayotganda karnay buzildi.

patterns.formula: X wasn't + V-ing. X was + V-ing.
patterns.exampleEn: Mr West wasn't walking into the room. He was sitting on a box.
patterns.exampleUz: Janob Uest xonaga kirmayotgan edi. U quti ustida o'tirgan edi.

patterns.formula: X + V2 while Y was + V-ing.
patterns.exampleEn: The loudspeaker broke while the band was playing.

patterns.formula: It was + V-ing as X + V2.
patterns.exampleEn: It was snowing heavily as the climbers reached the camp.
patterns.exampleUz: Alpinistlar lagerga yetganda qattiq qor yog'ayotgan edi.

patterns.exampleEn: It stopped raining, so the children went out to play.
